five source tuples resolved and 40/40 artifact SHAs attested
40/40 package/grant cross-consistency and quantized byte geometry
ledger and canonical graph pins verified

findings.evidence: D0 requires 10 same-process and 10 fresh-process exact-byte repetitions for 20 stages, while the reviewed one-attempt consumer ran only once and had one fixed capture root.
findings.failure_mode: The single granted attempt could not produce the repetition evidence required by its own D0 contract.
findings.required_repair: Represent all 20 subruns under one durable qualification event or bind a separately granted determinism consumer.

findings.evidence: Ordinals 10-12 correctly replace an unresolvable historical path/bundle-hash tuple with router reuse authorization v2, but no committed authority-repair record explained the substitution or package-root delta.
findings.failure_mode: The substantively correct repair was silent and not independently reconstructible without archaeology.
findings.required_repair: Commit an append-only authority-repair record binding the defective tuple, replacement, affected ordinals, and both roots.

findings.evidence: Duplicate roles were not marked consumed and the receipt census checked only length.
findings.failure_mode: A modified consumer could omit one role and duplicate another.
findings.required_repair: Reject duplicate reads and enforce exact ordinal set.

findings.evidence: after_sha256 rehashed the first in-memory buffer rather than an independent descriptor readback.
findings.required_repair: Perform independent descriptor readback or narrow the claim.

findings.evidence: Durable attempt state and runtime/dylib checks were deferred outside the committed consumer.
findings.failure_mode: A pre-capture crash or runtime drift could evade local enforcement.
findings.required_repair: Commit wrapper-owned durable start before reads and runtime identity checks.

findings.evidence: Mutations exercised the Python validator more deeply than the Rust enforcer and source commit ancestry was unchecked.
findings.failure_mode: Execution-path enforcement could regress independently of the mirror.
findings.required_repair: Add Rust enforcement tests and verify source commit ancestry.

statement: Roots, hashes, source tuples, checkpoint unreachability, and scope held. Acceptance failed because D0 repetition evidence was unrepresentable and the ordinal 10-12 authority repair was undocumented. No retained bytes, checkpoint data, qualification, P1, or authorization was used.
